about_the_game:
Grimdelve is a unique, story-driven RPG inspired by genre masterpieces like Underrail and Disco Elysium! Your choices matter and will influence the story in ways both small and large!

DESIGN THEIR PERSONALITIES:

Mix and match 16 different traits to create wildly different people. Become a mysterious weirdo, a charismatic smooth-talker, or someone completely nonsensical. Traits don't just affect dialogue, they affect gameplay too! In one playthrough you may have to solve puzzles by pushing boulders, while in another you can smash right through them. There is an incredible freedom of choice, with the aim of over 12,870 different IMPACTFUL build choices in the final release.

EXPLORE THE CAVERNS:

Caverns are a dangerous place. Spikey stalagmites, steep cliffs, fast underground rivers, and deep holes are just some of the obstacles you will face. Mistakes are permanent, though they may not always lead to death. Sometimes it just means missing out on that shiny ruby...

KEY FEATURES:

  • EVERYTHING responds to your choices

  • Minigame based exploration

  • Plenty of secrets to uncover

  • Alternate history story with rich emotional themes

short_description: Beneath the dead earth of 800s Slovenia, there are no heroes. Play as a starving boy with nothing but his wits and a lost princess clawing at purpose. All you have are the choices you make, and who they will force you to become.
